system.description:
ESSENCE HEALING SOUL UTILITY
Tradition divinity
Cast 1 minute (material, somatic, verbal)
Range touch
Targets 1 creature, corpse or object associated with a bound soul

You strike at supernatural bonds holding a soul where it does not belong.
Select one magical effect that imprisons a soul, binds a soul to a creature, corpse, location or object, forcibly displaces a soul, maintains possession, or directly controls a soul. Attempt to Counteract the effect.
Critical: The effect ends. If the affected creature is living, reduce its Soul Drain by 10 and it gains a +4-status bonus against the same source attempting to affect its soul again for 24 hours.
Success: The effect ends.
Failure: The bond remains intact.
Fumble: The bond remains intact and cannot be targeted by another casting of Sever Soulchain from you for 24 hours.
The spell does not resurrect the dead, compel an unwilling soul to return to a body or destroy a soul merely because its bond has been severed.

Warping Options:
+4 PP: Attempt to sever one additional soul-binding effect associated with the same target.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
